svg.title: Nine ways information crosses the wall
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Nine ways information crosses the wall” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A padlocked dashed wall divides a TRAIN block from the test side, crossed by nine red arrows whose thickness is proportional to the measured inflation each kind of leakage produces, from 33.50 points for feature selection on all labels down to 2.28 for duplicate rows, with a green Pipeline box below noted as blocking five of the nine by construction and a shuffled-label test whose 0.72 bar is crossed out against the 0.50 it should have produced.
svg.text: Nine ways information crosses the wall
draw it from memory, then compare
